scanTypeId.description: The scan type id. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=ScanTypes

scanType.description: The scan type. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=ScanTypes

assessmentTypeId.description: The assessment type id. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/releases/{releaseId}/assessment-types

assessmentTypeName.description: The assessment type name. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/releases/{releaseId}/assessment-types

analysisStatusTypeId.description: The analysis status type id. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=AnalysisStatusTypes

analysisStatusType.description: The analysis status type. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=AnalysisStatusTypes

isFalsePositiveChallenge.description: Indicates if the scan is a false positive challenge

isRemediationScan.description: Indicates if the scan is a remediation scan

entitlementId.description: The entitlement id used for the given scan

entitlementUnitsConsumed.description: The number of entitlement units used for the given scan

isSubscriptionEntitlement.description: Indicates if the entitlement used for the given scan is a subscription entitlement

pauseDetails.description: The details for each time the scan has been paused/resumed.

scanMethodTypeId.description: The scan method type id. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=ScanMethodTypes

scanMethodTypeName.description: The scan method type name. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=ScanMethodTypes

scanPolicyTypeId.description: The scan policy type id. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=ScanPolicyTypes

scanPolicyTypeName.description: The scan policy type name. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=ScanPolicyTypes

scanToolVersion.description: The version for the scan tool used for scanning

reason.description: The reason the scan was paused.

notes.description: Optional notes regarding the scan paused.
